textos.Várias pessoas deste grupo reclamam que: Several people in this group complain that the film drags on for more than two and a half hours, with pauses and repetition that make the tension dissipate instead of build, making the experience tiring and unrewarding.
textos.Este grupo considera que a trama avança: This group considers that the plot goes in circles, piling up twists and contradictory clues that never fit together, leaving the sense that the story lacks internal logical structure.
textos.Para essas reviews, os personagens tomam: For these reviews, the characters make decisions that border on the absurd and seem to exist only as pieces of a badly assembled plot, which makes it impossible to care about them or take the story seriously.
textos.Essas críticas afirmam que o desfecho de: These reviews state that the ending leaves questions unanswered gratuitously, without the rewarding ambiguity of a well-built work, resulting in a taste of emptiness and frustration at the end.
textos.Vários textos apontam que o filme não co: Several texts point out that the film fails to generate effective suspense or scares, with scenes that follow one another without building any apprehension, and some even say they laughed more than they were scared.
textos.Excesso de elementos e gêneros misturado: Too many elements and mixed genres
textos.Este grupo reclama que a obra empilha el: This group complains that the work piles up elements of zombies, exorcism, shamanism and police investigation without cohesion, resulting in a jumble of ideas that loses focus and identity.
textos.Várias reviews medianas reclamam que o f: Several middling reviews complain that the film is too long for the idea it carries, with a running time that could be cut by at least half an hour, making the experience tiring and at times boring.
textos.Muitos espectadores deste grupo relatam: Many viewers in this group report difficulty following the plot, feeling lost amid so many twists, subplots and possible interpretations, which creates frustration instead of engagement.
textos.As reviews apontam que o filme não decid: Reviews point out that the film cannot decide whether it is a comedy, drama, horror or police investigation, mixing genres in a way that leaves the tone inconsistent and some comic scenes feel out of place.

textos.A performance da atriz mirim é frequente: The young actress's performance is often praised as the film's strongest point, while other characters, especially the police protagonist, are seen as irritating or not very convincing.
textos.Roteiro com furos e falta de explicação: Script with holes and lack of explanation
textos.Vários textos mencionam buracos no rotei: Several texts mention plot holes and poorly explained information, with decisions that seem aimed only at shock, abandoning the story's internal logic.
textos.Algumas reviews destacam a boa fotografi: Some reviews highlight the good cinematography, with striking rural landscapes and an atmosphere of tension and mystery that works well in many moments.
textos.Várias reviews positivas apontam que o f: Several positive reviews point out that the film is too long and that the drawn-out pace in certain stretches hurts the experience, with some suggesting that cuts of twenty to thirty minutes would improve the flow.
textos.Mistério ambíguo e confusão sobre quem c: Ambiguous mystery and confusion about whom to trust
textos.Este grupo destaca que a trama mantém o: This group highlights that the plot keeps the viewer in doubt about who the real villain is and what is real, with twists that disorient and leave the audience not knowing whom to believe until the end.
textos.As reviews elogiam as atuações, especial: Reviews praise the performances, especially the child's, and describe the protagonist as a bumbling cop devoted to his family, which produces both humor and compassion.
textos.Muitas reviews positivas exaltam a cinem: Many positive reviews praise the cinematography, with emphasis on the dark beauty of the rural landscapes and the damp, anguishing atmosphere that contributes to the horror mood.
textos.Algumas reviews interpretam o filme como: Some reviews interpret the film as a critique of Japanese colonialism and discrimination, in addition to exploring religious beliefs and Korean shamanism allegorically.
textos.Ausência de jumpscares e terror psicológ: No jump scares and psychological horror
textos.Este grupo ressalta que o filme não depe: This group stresses that the film does not depend on cheap scares, but on a constant psychological tension that leaves the viewer uncomfortable and apprehensive.

textos.Dirigido por Na Hong-jin e lançado em 20: Directed by Na Hong-jin and released in 2016, The Wailing is a horror and mystery film with a running time of 156 minutes. The narrative follows a quiet village shaken by cruel murders after the arrival of a mysterious stranger, leading an investigating officer to turn to a shaman when his daughter is struck by the same magic.
textos.A experiência apresenta um ritmo deliber: The experience presents a deliberately measured pace and a dense atmosphere, structured around a plot full of ambiguous clues and constant twists. Throughout its running time, the work also combines different genre conventions within its investigative mood.
textos.Os diferentes grupos concordam sobre o q: The different groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~83%), some point out that the excessive running time and slow pace affect the flow, while a portion value the ambiguous mystery and the doubt about whom to trust, and a smaller slice highlight the presence of striking performances and characters.
textos.Entre as avaliações reunidas numa fração: Among the reviews gathered in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~13%), about half criticize the drawn-out pace and long length, a significant share report frustration with the narrative confusion and excessive ambiguity, and several point to an imbalance in the mix of tones.
textos.Já sob a perspectiva adotada numa fração: From the perspective taken in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~4%), nearly half condemn the slow pace for hurting the tension, around half judge the script confusing and lacking internal coherence, and a considerable number reject the handling of the characters, considering them poorly built.
